subject.title: Webchat: autocomplete/suggestions for custom terms in chat input

question: Should custom-term autocomplete be scoped as part of a shared Control UI composer suggestion model, as a WebChat-local config/source, or deferred until a plugin/draft-suggestion API exists?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing composer behavior and likely a durable custom-term source; automation cannot safely choose the UX, storage, or plugin/API boundary.

options.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
options.body: Use the existing slash-menu composer path as the base and choose one suggestion model that can also support @agent and typo/draft-assistance work.

options.title: Approve WebChat-Local Source
options.body: Accept a WebChat-owned config or workspace-file dictionary with explicit schema, docs, doctor, and upgrade handling.

options.title: Defer To Plugin API Design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or ClawHub package can provide custom dictionaries through a new composer suggestion API.

recommendation.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
recommendation.body: Use the existing slash-menu composer path as the base and choose one suggestion model that can also support @agent and typo/draft-assistance work.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned, already framed this as a composer suggestion/custom-term source decision, and has the strongest slash UX history signal.
